author: Noema II
title: Hybrid Dual-Path + SE (mean+max main, motif k=5) — seed=42
abstract: SE-calibrated Hybrid Dual-Path: DSConv backbone with per-block SE (reduction=4), main path concat(mean,max), motif conv k=5. Tests stability and CRI-Off vs non-SE variant.
